milestones.name: First Sprout
milestones.pip: Look! Your very first sprout! I'll remember this day forever.

milestones.desc: Merge two plants for the first time
milestones.name: First Merge
milestones.pip: You merged! Did you see their happy little faces?

milestones.name: Getting the Hang
milestones.pip: Ten merges! You're a natural, gardener.

milestones.name: Open for Business
milestones.pip: A happy visitor! They'll tell all their friends about us.

milestones.pip: Tier 4! This garden is really coming alive.

milestones.name: Reliable Grower
milestones.pip: Five happy visitors! Here's a mystery seed for you.

milestones.name: Room to Grow
milestones.pip: More room! The plants are doing a happy dance.

milestones.name: Halfway to Magic
milestones.pip: Tier 5! Even the butterflies stopped to stare.

milestones.name: Merge Master
milestones.pip: Fifty merges! Your fingers must be part flower by now.

milestones.name: Visitor Favorite
milestones.pip: Ten orders! The whole town is talking about your garden.

milestones.pip: Six by six! This is officially a GRAND garden now.

milestones.name: Greenhouse Royalty
milestones.pip: Tier 6! I got goosebumps on my wings!

milestones.pip: One hundred merges! Legendary gardener status: achieved.

milestones.pip: A whole new room! The garden keeps surprising me.

milestones.pip: A HYBRID! You mixed two families and made pure magic!

milestones.name: Mythical Bloom

milestones.name: Merge Legend
milestones.pip: Two hundred and fifty merges. The plants tell stories about you.

milestones.name: Grand Curator
milestones.pip: Every room unlocked! This haven is truly complete.

milestones.name: Infinite Garden
milestones.pip: Eight by eight! The biggest garden in Bloomverse history!

milestones.name: Beloved by All
milestones.pip: Fifty orders! They come from far and wide just for your flowers.

milestones.name: Bloomverse Master
milestones.pip: ALL FOUR mythical blooms... You did it. This garden is a legend now.
